seoTitle: Partners — Chambers of commerce, business schools, press and consulting | datixxia™
seoDescription: Chambers of commerce, business schools, journalist organisations and consulting firms can partner with datixxia™ to bring forward-looking intelligence to their networks.

hero.label: Partners
hero.title: Research, innovation & global reach
hero.lead: We partner with those who move the economy forward: trade, education, the press and economic advisory.

fourPartners.label: Our partners
fourPartners.title: Four key partners for a smart economy
fourPartners.intro: We invite four categories of partners to join us.

cards.title: Chambers of commerce
cards.text: Because the exchange of goods, services and ideas is the source of all prosperity.

cards.title: Business schools
cards.text: Because without education there is no future — and without research there is no progress.

cards.title: Journalist organisations
cards.text: Because without a free press there is no democracy.

cards.title: Economic consulting firms
cards.text: Because beyond “business intelligence”, the world needs intelligent businesses.

note.label: Country representatives
note.text: We invite them to become our representatives in every country.

chambers.label: For our intelligence partners
chambers.lead: By analysing awarded public contracts, datixxia™ helps you understand economic commitments for the months and years ahead. Support businesses, enrich teaching and research, open new lines of investigation or inform your clients’ decisions.
chambers.text: As an intelligence partner, share these possibilities with your networks and develop a new source of revenue for your organisation.
chambers.closing: With datixxia™, put economic intelligence at the service of your mission.

lsp.label: How it works
lsp.lead: Our partners bring datixxia™ to their own networks — with local knowledge that no dataset can replace.

cards.title: Join the network
cards.text: Choose your partner category and agree with us on the framework of our collaboration.

cards.title: Share with your network
cards.text: Introduce datixxia™ to the people and organisations you work with — in their language, with your local expertise.

cards.title: Shape the platform
cards.text: Share feedback from the field and help datixxia™ improve with every release.

form.label: Contact us
form.lead: Want more information, or have a question you couldn’t find an answer to on the website? Contact us.

cta.title: Let’s build the future together.
cta.text: Join the datixxia™ intelligence partner network: chambers of commerce, business schools, journalist organisations and economic consulting firms.
